description: General-purpose Q&A knowledge base schema for bootcamp information

questions.description: 3-5 diverse phrasings of the same question to maximize query matching. Use different sentence structures, formal/informal variations, and question types.
example: How do I get help if I'm stuck?
Who should I contact for support?
Where do I ask questions when I need assistance?

answer.description: Concise, actionable answer with specific details (names, links, dates, steps). Answer should be self-contained and directly usable.
answer.example: Contact Amir Feizpour on Slack (@Amir Feizpour) or email bootcamp@ai.science. Don't wait more than 1-2 days if you're stuck.

keyphrases.description: 10-20 multi-word phrases and semantic variations for matching. Focus on phrases (2-4 words) rather than single keywords. Include synonyms, related concepts, and common misspellings if applicable.

category.description: Primary category for organizational filtering. Use snake_case.

last_updated.description: Date this entry was last modified

links.description: Relevant URLs mentioned in the answer (Calendly links, documentation, etc.)

design_principles.generalization: Schema should work for any Q&A knowledge base, not just bootcamp logistics
design_principles.query_optimization: Keyphrases designed for jq string matching with contains()
design_principles.answer_completeness: Answers should be self-contained with actionable information
design_principles.category_simplicity: Single-level categorization, let keyphrases handle nuance
